strike.linked: "{item}" is applied automatically by the Strike: {strike}. Hold Alt when sending to chat to get the manual card.

events.useNeedsAuto: "{name}": using the item on an event works only in the "Automatic" mode — the item was not used.
events.host: "{item}": {target} must attempt a challenge against the ability's owner.
events.zone: "{item}": {target} is in the area and must attempt a challenge.
events.pick: "{item}": {target} - a reaction check against the chosen target.
events.linger: "{item}": {target} attempts a check; the DC is set by the highest-level creature of the composition: allies in its area or its targets, {n} creature(s) (for compositions aimed at enemies, e.g. Dirge of Doom, allies count). The GM may change the DC.

hold.waiting: The attack is held: the attacker must first pass the target's protection (see the challenge card).
hold.cancelled: The attack is cancelled, the action is spent: do not roll or apply damage.
hold.counterWaiting: The casting is held: a counterspell is being decided. The spell's effect is not running yet, the buttons are hidden.
hold.counterCancelled: The casting was countered: its effect does not run. The cost of casting is spent.

hold.step: A hold step is release, cancel or end ({path})

trg.on: A zone trigger has no event: enter, start or end of turn ({path})
trg.per: "At most" is once per round or once per turn ({path})
trg.to: Zone trigger steps apply only to the creature in the area (to: target) ({path})
trg.empty: The zone trigger is empty: add steps or a challenge ({path})

ev.on: An event entry has no event from the list ({path})
ev.side: The event side is owner, roll target or origin ({path})
ev.sideTarget: "Roll target" exists only for rolls and spell casting ({path})
ev.afterUse: "After use" is yes or no, and only for the owner's own roll (attack, check, save, damage) ({path})
ev.check: A check exists for spell casting with "after use" (level DC) or for "damage taken" with a choose step (against a defense); not together with a challenge ({path})
ev.cost: "Reaction" is only reaction; the choose step, if any, comes first ({path})
ev.counter: Counterspell: only for "spell cast" on the "in the owner's aura" side with a reaction; needs mod (integer) or statistic, and rank 1-10 or {half: "actor"}; expend is same-spell or same-rank ({path})
ev.free: "Free if" is a predicate and only together with a reaction ({path})
ev.hold: "Hold" is only true, only for the roll target's attack or a check ({path})
ev.use: "Use item" is only true, only for the owner's entry and only for damage taken, turn start and turn end, without a challenge or check ({path})
ev.holdStep: A hold step exists only in an entry with hold ({path})
ev.empty: The event entry is empty: add steps, a challenge or "use the item" ({path})
ev.onArray: An array of events in "on" exists only for the "familiar" side ({path})
ev.familiarSteps: The "familiar" side has no reaction and no target/allies/party steps; a challenge needs a creature choose step before it ({path})
ev.familiar: The "familiar" side exists only for casting or Sustaining a spell, and Sustaining is only for it ({path})
ev.nearOn: The "in aura" side exists only for start of turn, end of turn and enter ({path})
ev.enter: Entering an aura is only for the "in the owner's aura" side ({path})
ev.nearZone: An "in aura" entry needs exactly one of: aura slug (aura) or range in feet (range > 0) ({path})
ev.nearOnly: Aura, range and "at most" exist only for the "in the owner's aura" side ({path})
ev.gate: Internal entry condition (gate): target - damage to the armed target, removed - the save only after the carrier was removed, idle - out of combat only ({path})

activate.dup: The rule has both activate and cast: keep only activate ({path})
activate.kind: Activation: exactly one of spell, choices, onUse is needed (or the pair spell + onUse); choices cannot be combined with the others ({path})
activate.label: Activation without a spell and without choices: a label is required ({path})
activate.choice: Choice option: needs spell or onUse, an option without spell needs a label; id is Latin and unique; rank and dc as in the entry, rank only together with spell ({path})
activate.dcForm: Activation step DC: only an object {value: N} or no dc is allowed (the against, source, expr, level, from forms and a bare number are not supported) (otherwise the entry's dc or the item-level DC is used) ({path})

cast.bad: Activation (activate): needs a spell (UUID), rank 1-10 or {half: actor|item, min}, DC as a number, level: high or {against: class-spell}, attack as a number, frequency as once per N rounds/minutes/hours/days, requirement invested, equipped, held or none; the key (id) is unique ({path})

afflict.bad: Step "affliction": an object with the definition def and an optional stage number is required ({path})
afflict.def: Affliction definition: name, kind (poison, disease, curse), virulent is yes or no only, traits are slugs ({path})
afflict.save: Affliction definition: the save is Fortitude, Reflex or Will, DC is an integer from 1 (may be omitted: taken from the challenge) ({path})
afflict.stage: Affliction stage: integer from 1 to the stage count; stage fields are duration, damage, persistent, conditions, mods, text ({path})
afflict.dur: Affliction duration: integer from 1 and a unit — rounds, minutes, hours or days ({path})
afflict.damage: Stage damage: up to four entries with a dice formula and a damage type ({path})
afflict.persistent: Stage persistent damage: dice formula, damage type, DC is an integer from 1 ({path})
afflict.conditions: Stage conditions: up to six distinct ones, slug and a value from 1 to 10 ({path})
afflict.mods: Stage penalties: the same properties as a step effect (up to four) ({path})
afflict.text: Stage text is a string of up to 600 characters ({path})
afflict.to: An affliction is applied to the target only (to: target) ({path})

coat.bad: Coat step: needs an object with weapon: "choose", a challenge and optionally a duration ({path})
coat.dur: Poison duration on the weapon: an integer from 1 (or 0 until turn end), a unit and the turn start or end ({path})
coat.challenge: Coat step: a challenge is required - what the poison does to the target ({path})
coat.to: A poison is applied to the owner's weapon (to: self) ({path})
coat.arm: Internal poison carrier step: true only ({path})
coat.place: The coat step is single and only in onUse.apply: not in events, challenge degrees or triggers ({path})

sheet.eventNote: The rule's events (roll, damage, turn, effect) are edited in the Workshop; they are kept unchanged here.
sheet.castNote: The item's activations (cast a spell) are edited in the Workshop; they are kept unchanged here.

when.onEvent: On event · run by the GM
when.cast: Item activation · cast by whoever presses the button

trg.hint: Zone triggers: what happens to a creature that enters the area or starts or ends its turn in it. The challenge and steps work as in events.

on.turn-start: Starts its turn in the area
on.turn-end: Ends its turn in the area

story.onEvent: The rule fires on events. Each has its own condition, steps and challenge.
story.cast: The item casts a spell from the button on its own card. After that the spell's own rule takes over.

ev.hint: "Self" is the rule's owner. "Target" is the other party of the event: the roll's target, the roller, or whoever bears the effect.
ev.whenHint: A pf2e predicate: options separated by commas (all at once) or JSON. Outcome is outcome:success.
ev.use: Use this item (card: area, saves, Damage)
ev.useBody: the item's card: area, saves, Damage
ev.hp0Hint: Fires on damage (pf2e button, persistent damage, module damage): HP were above 0 and dropped to 0. Editing HP on the sheet does not count.
ev.afterUse: Only for the roll right after this item's card
ev.freeHint: A predicate over the owner's options: when true the reaction is not spent.

side.near: in the owner's aura (enemy/ally — in the challenge)
side.familiar: familiar ability of the casting witch

ev.zoneAuraHint: Either the slug of a pf2e rules aura (frightful-aura) or range in feet from the owner

cast.hint: One entry is one activation ("You cast ..."). DC and rank can stay empty: they come from the owner and the spell. Drop a spell on the field or anywhere on the row.
cast.durTip: The entry's own duration instead of the spell's (number or a 1d4 die). Empty keeps the spell rule's duration.
cast.dcTip: Empty: the activation’s DC is used, then the item-level DC.
cast.areaFromDesc: The area template is taken from the item description.
cast.idTip: Latin letters. Use counters are keyed by it: change it and the counters are lost.

why.equipped: The item must be worn or held.
why.noSpell: The activation spell is not in the world's compendia.

cast.noCaster: The owner has no spellcasting and the rule gives no DC: it cannot be cast.
cast.again: The activation limit is spent ("{name}"). Use anyway?

coat.name: {poison} → {weapon}
coat.desc: The poison is on "{weapon}": it works on the target of the first Strike with this weapon that hits, once piercing or slashing damage is applied to it.
coat.noSP: not piercing or slashing: the poison will not work on it
coat.noSPNote: "{name}": "{weapon}" is not piercing or slashing - the poison on it is spent without effect.
coat.needsAuto: "{name}": weapon poison works only with the effects mode set to Automatic - the poison was not applied.
coat.noWeapon: "{name}": no weapon to apply the poison to.
coat.noDC: "{name}": the poison DC is unknown - the poison was not applied.
coat.replaced: "{name}": the poison "{old}" on "{weapon}" was replaced by "{poison}".

affliction.ended: "{item}": the maximum duration on {target} has run out — the affliction ends.

apply.afflictionNoDC: "{name}": the affliction DC is unknown — not applied.
apply.afflictionTaken: "{name}": "{item}" is already active — a repeated exposure adds no stages (disease and curse).

chat.stepStageDelta: shift the affliction stage by the degree (success down, failure up)
chat.stepRemoveKey: remove the effect that called for the save

stepHold.cancel: the held attack is cancelled (the action is wasted)
stepHold.end: the held attack goes through and the protecting effect ends

chat.stepCoat: coat a poison on a weapon (choose the weapon)
